notes:

phase_0.boundary_condition: the sealed field transcript that contains the disc's bilateral spiral readings
phase_0.domain_name: Phaistos Disc structural transcription pipeline split bilateral spiral into
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: moves the raw disc image toward ordered side words, segment words, stamp types, and semantic fields

AREV.justification: returns to lower resolution evidence when a side, word, stamp, or semantic field cannot be affirmed

CLINK.justification: composes side, word, stamp, and semantic operations into one ordered field transcript

ENGAGR.justification: keeps a supported and unsupported semantic field live at the same time before fusion

EVALF.justification: marks a side, word, stamp, or semantic field as constructively unsupported or damaged

EVALT.justification: marks a side, word, stamp, or semantic field as constructively supported by the image

FFUSE.justification: rejoins obverse and reverse arms and their word, stamp, and semantic subarms into one transcript state

FSPLIT.justification: opens the disc into obverse and reverse spiral arms and later into word, stamp, and semantic arms

IFIX.justification: writes the field transcript into an append only record that cannot be undone

IMSCRIB.justification: the transcript recognizes itself as the same disc layout without changing the reading

TANCH.justification: the closed boundary that contains the completed bilateral spiral transcription and stops further mutation

VINIT.justification: the pipeline begins before any side, word, stamp, or semantic field is named

phase_2.fuse_result: single field transcript state containing side words, segment words, stamp types, and semantic fields
phase_2.rejoin_note: obverse and reverse arms run side word extraction, word segmentation, stamp classification, and semantic field assignment, then rejoin into one transcript.
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) both held at once: a live contradiction, the paraconsistent resolution
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) neither: uninitialized, nothing established

steps.domain_action: untranscribed disc image enters the pipeline
normalize both spiral sides into ordered image strips
branch on bilateral spiral sides
obverse spiral side is legible and segmented
extract obverse side words from the spiral strip
branch on obverse word segmentation
obverse word boundaries are clear
segment obverse clear words into glyph sequences
obverse word boundaries are ambiguous
descend to obverse spacing and stamp repetition cues
rejoin obverse segmented and repaired words into obverse segment words
branch on obverse stamp type classification
obverse stamp type is recognized
assign canonical obverse stamp types
obverse stamp type is uncertain
descend to obverse variant glyph forms
rejoin obverse recognized and variant stamps into obverse stamp types
branch on obverse semantic field assignment
obverse semantic field is supported
map obverse stamps to semantic fields
obverse semantic field is unsupported
descend to obverse neutral placeholder fields
hold obverse supported and unsupported semantic fields as a live dual reading
rejoin obverse semantic and placeholder fields into obverse semantic fields
reverse spiral side is damaged or illegible
descend to lower resolution reverse stamp evidence
extract reverse side words from the damaged spiral strip
branch on reverse word segmentation
reverse word boundaries are clear
segment reverse clear words into glyph sequences
reverse word boundaries are ambiguous
descend to reverse spacing and stamp repetition cues
rejoin reverse segmented and repaired words into reverse segment words
branch on reverse stamp type classification
reverse stamp type is recognized
assign canonical reverse stamp types
reverse stamp type is uncertain
descend to reverse variant glyph forms
rejoin reverse recognized and variant stamps into reverse stamp types
branch on reverse semantic field assignment
reverse semantic field is supported
map reverse stamps to semantic fields
reverse semantic field is unsupported
descend to reverse neutral placeholder fields
hold reverse supported and unsupported semantic fields as a live dual reading
rejoin reverse semantic and placeholder fields into reverse semantic fields
rejoin obverse and reverse side words, segment words, stamp types, and semantic fields into a bilateral field transcript
chain side words, segment words, stamp types, and semantic fields into one ordered transcript
verify the transcript identity against the source disc layout
append the field transcript to the permanent corpus
close the pipeline at the sealed field transcript

phase_5.alfs_store: the canonical reference store holding the sealed field transcript and source layout
phase_5.compiler_frontend: the rule set that turns disc image intentions into side, word, stamp, and field operations
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: side, word, stamp, and semantic layers exchange readings through ordered message slots
phase_5.memory_mechanism: state is stored in a stamp index keyed by side, position, word, type, and field
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: it orders operations by spiral position, then side, word, stamp, and semantic field

phase_6.cycle_cost: one image normalization and one stamp classification per cycle
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0: the pipeline consumes image ambiguity and returns it as recorded uncertainty in the transcript
phase_6.post_cycle_state: ordered field transcript with side words, segment words, stamp types, and semantic fields
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: raw disc image with unassigned sides, words, stamps, and fields
